description: This file is a shell script that manages inter-chip communication and telemetry operations between ARM and ATOM interfaces, including starting/stopping daemons, copying profiles, and notifying events.

methods.name: dropbearRecovery
methods.description: Recovers or starts the dropbear SSH server if not running.

methods.name: sshCmdOnAtom
methods.description: Executes an SSH command on the ATOM interface with retries.

methods.name: sshCmdOnArm
methods.description: Executes an SSH command on the ARM interface with retries.

methods.name: startInterChipDaemon
methods.description: Starts the telemetry daemon on the inter-chip interface.

methods.name: stopInterChipDaemon
methods.description: Stops the telemetry daemon on the inter-chip interface.

methods.name: copyProfileToAtom
methods.description: Copies the profile configuration file to the ATOM interface.

methods.name: notifyGetGrepResultFromAtom
methods.description: Notifies the ATOM to report grep results.

methods.name: notifyProfileRemoveToAtom
methods.description: Notifies the ATOM to remove a profile.

methods.name: startT2DaemonOnAtom
methods.description: Starts the telemetry 2.0 daemon on the ATOM interface.

methods.name: notifyERReadyToAtom
methods.description: Notifies the ATOM that the event receiver is ready.

methods.name: copyLogsFromArm
methods.description: Copies logs from ARM to local storage.

methods.name: notifyDaemonStarted
methods.description: Notifies ARM that the daemon has started.

methods.name: notifyDaemonFailed
methods.description: Notifies ARM that the daemon has failed.

methods.name: copyJsonResultToArm
methods.description: Copies grep result JSON to ARM.

methods.name: copyT2CacheFileToArm
methods.description: Copies telemetry cache file to ARM.
